def target(self, piece, radial, angular, *, common_q=False):
        M, Kernel = self.M, self.Kernel
        if common_q:
            phi = self.common.first_angle.derivatives(M, M.interval(*angular), 1)[1]
            local = M.bounds(phi)
            known = M.bounds(self.common.first_angle.global_derivative_interval(M))
            theta = max(local[0], known[0]), min(local[1], known[1])
            require(0 < theta[0] <= theta[1], "The actual first material derivative bounds disagree")
        else:
            value, _ = Kernel.angle_density(self.current.field, M, angular)
            theta = M.bounds(value)
        if piece["kind"] == "prefix":
            jets, radial_metric, target_record = self.current.target.closed_range(*radial)
            if jets[0].lo <= 0:
                return None, dict(reason="accurate_prefix_radius_positive_lower_unresolved", target=target_record)
            g11 = radial_metric.lo, radial_metric.hi
            if common_q:
                scale = self.common.numeric_length
                g11 = multiply(g11, (scale*scale, scale*scale))
            g22 = multiply(square((jets[0].lo, jets[0].hi)), square(theta))
            record = dict(kind="complete_accurate_ten_public_u", target=target_record)
            if self.data["sixjet_diagnostic_enabled"]:
                record["same_evaluation_sixjet_target"] = dict(
                    schema=self.Diagnostic.CONTEXT_SCHEMA,
                    coordinate="prefix_public_u" if common_q else "prefix_numeric_s",
                    radius=encode((jets[0].lo, jets[0].hi)),
                    accurate_radius_first_derivative=encode((jets[1].lo, jets[1].hi)),
                    radius_derivative_rule="accurate_a_s_times_positive_sqrt_g11",
                    radial_metric=encode(g11), angular_density=encode(theta),
                    angular_map_independent_of_radial_coordinate=True,
                    all_original_target_pieces_and_semantic_C_members_retained=True)
            return (g11, g22), record
        require(piece["kind"] in ("native", "collar"), "Do not omit an unknown accurate active piece")
        bound = self.tail.bounds(*radial)
        if bound is None:
            return None, dict(reason="same_C_whole_closed_radial_target_unpaid", radial=encode(radial))
        lo, hi, rows = bound
        record = dict(kind="same_complete_C_radial", radial=encode(radial), actual_query_rows=rows,
            geometric_Bprime_not_substituted=True)
        if self.data["sixjet_diagnostic_enabled"]:
            record["same_evaluation_sixjet_target"] = dict(
                schema=self.Diagnostic.CONTEXT_SCHEMA, coordinate="radial_r",
                radius=encode(radial), radius_derivative_rule="radial_identity",
                radial_metric=encode((lo, hi)), angular_density=encode(theta),
                angular_map_independent_of_radial_coordinate=True,
                all_original_target_pieces_and_semantic_C_members_retained=True)
        return ((lo, hi), multiply(square(radial), square(theta))), record

    def sixjet_observe(self, address, jets, target_record, journal):
        if not self.data["sixjet_diagnostic_enabled"]:
            return dict(enabled=False, observation_started=False,
                original_direct_Gram_unchanged=True)
        index = self.diagnostic.start(address)
        if jets is None:
            report = dict(schema=DIAGNOSTIC_SCHEMA, original_target_unavailable=True,
                angular_ratio_available=False, radial_angular_defect_available=False,
                algebraic_reference_velocities_available=False,
                unpaid=[dict(scope="same_evaluation", reason="original_target_did_not_return",
                    original_reason=target_record.get("reason"))],
                extra_field_or_C_query_count=0, original_direct_Gram_not_replaced=True)
        else:
            try:
                bounds = [[self.M.bounds(component) for component in row] for row in jets]
                report = self.Diagnostic.diagnose(bounds,
                    target_record["same_evaluation_sixjet_target"], self.data["work"]["sqrt_bits"])
            except (ArithmeticError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                report = dict(schema=DIAGNOSTIC_SCHEMA,
                    angular_ratio_available=False, radial_angular_defect_available=False,
                    algebraic_reference_velocities_available=False,
                    diagnostic_error=dict(type=type(error).__name__, message=str(error)),
                    unpaid=[dict(scope="same_evaluation", reason="optional_diagnostic_did_not_return")],
                    original_direct_Gram_not_replaced=True, no_original_scientific_failure_inferred=True)
        # The original signal handler only sets a flag. Complete this observation
        # and its metadata before the next original budget check. A hard kill
        # still belongs to the outer real owner; no marker is invented.
        journal.append(dict(type="same_evaluation_sixjet_diagnostic",
            observation_index=index, address=copy.deepcopy(address), result=report,
            observation_not_original_cover_or_phase_transaction_completion=True))
        self.diagnostic.complete(index, address, report)
        return dict(enabled=True, observation_started=True, observation_index=index,
            angular_ratio_available=report.get("angular_ratio_available", False),
            radial_angular_defect_available=report.get("radial_angular_defect_available", False),
            algebraic_reference_velocities_available=report.get("algebraic_reference_velocities_available", False),
            unpaid_scope_count=len(report.get("unpaid", [])),
            diagnostic_error=copy.deepcopy(report.get("diagnostic_error")),
            full_local_record_in_same_original_ledger=True,
            original_direct_Gram_unchanged=True)
